quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: You should allow extra space when following:

options.text: A station wagon.
A driver who cannot see behind their vehicle.
A small passenger car.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver who cannot see behind their vehicle.
questions.explanation: Drivers of trucks, buses, vans, and vehicles towing trailers cannot see you if you drive directly behind them. Leave more space between you and these vehicles. Large vehicles also block your view of the road ahead, so increase your distance to see around them.

questions.question: If bad weather makes it hard to see, you should:

options.text: Speed up to leave the area quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.
Increase your following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase your following distance.
questions.explanation: When darkness or bad weather makes it hard to see, increase your following distance. This gives you more time to react to dangers you cannot see ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which way traffic must go. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: You see pedestrians near the road. You should:

options.text: Sound your horn and keep your speed.
Speed up to clear the area quickly.
Slow down and pass with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and pass with caution.
questions.explanation: Watch for pedestrians who may cross your path. If you see pedestrians near the road, slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: You can pass from the lane with the solid yellow line.
No one can pass from either direction.
You can pass from the lane with the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane with the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means traffic on the side of the broken line can pass. Traffic on the side of the solid line cannot pass.

questions.question: Roads are most slippery:

options.text: When it has been raining hard for several hours.
When they are clean and dry.
Just after it starts to rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: Just after it starts to rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery during the first half hour of rain. Water mixes with oil and chemicals on the road that have not yet washed away. Use extra caution on slippery roads.

questions.question: If dust or smoke blocks your view, you should drive slowly and turn on your:

options.text: Emergency flashers.
Parking lights.
Headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Headlights.
questions.explanation: Turn on your headlights whenever you cannot see other vehicles clearly. Other drivers also need to see you.

questions.question: In fog or mist, do not use high beam headlights because:

options.text: The light reflects back into your eyes.
Other vehicles may not see you.
Vehicles behind you may follow too close.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light reflects back into your eyes.
questions.explanation: In fog or mist, high beam headlights reflect back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: Which is a dangerous habit in work zones?

options.text: Following another vehicle too closely.
Not watching for workers and equipment.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: In work zones, slow down for traffic, keep distance from other vehicles, and watch carefully for workers and equipment.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No U-turn.
No left turn.
No right turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Turning right here would be unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: A yellow traffic light warns that it will soon turn red. If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, what should you do?

options.text: Stop.
Continue and safely clear the intersection.
Speed up to avoid causing an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue and safely clear the intersection.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, drive through as quickly as possible to clear it safely.

questions.question: You and another driver reach a four-way stop at the same time. The other driver is on your left. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The driver on your left.
You have the right-of-way.
Whoever is signaling to turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: You have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: When two drivers arrive at a four-way stop at the same time, the driver on the right has the right-of-way.

questions.question: Before you start the car, you should:

options.text: Buckle your safety belt.
Make sure all passengers have buckled their safety belts.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: Create a habit when getting in and out of your car. Before starting the engine, buckle your belt and make sure all passengers do the same.

questions.question: A red traffic light is showing, but a police officer tells you to go through the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Wait until the light turns green.
Go through the intersection as the officer directed.
Come to a complete stop first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go through the intersection as the officer directed.
questions.explanation: A police officer's directions always come before traffic signals and signs. Follow what the officer tells you to do.

questions.question: What color are traffic control signs in construction and maintenance work areas?

options.text: Red.
Orange.
Yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Orange.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about work zones. Be extra careful when you see orange signs, cones, or barriers on the road.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign mean?

options.text: Right turns only.
Right turns permitted.
No passing zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone.
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: How many drinks does it take to affect your driving ability?

options.text: Three
Two
One

questions.correctAnswerText: One
questions.explanation: Do not drive after drinking any amount of alcohol. Even one drink affects your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: A child is about to run into the street in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Start slowing down.
Flash your headlights.
Blow your horn loudly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn loudly.
questions.explanation: Use a sharp horn blast when a child or pedestrian is about to step into the street in front of your car.

questions.question: Before you enter a curve, you should:

options.text: Turn on your turn signal.
Slow down.
Brake hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: You may drive slower than the speed limit based on road conditions, but never faster. Reduce speed for curves, hills with limited vision, slippery roads, and areas with animals or pedestrians.

questions.question: A red arrow pointing right on a traffic light means you may:

options.text: Turn right after slowing and checking for traffic.
Not turn right until the light turns green.
Turn right after stopping completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not turn right until the light turns green.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means stop. You must stay stopped until a green light or green arrow appears. Do not turn against a red arrow.

questions.question: When leaving a parallel parking space on the side of the road, you should:

options.text: Turn on the correct turn signal.
Look over your shoulder.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: If parked on the right side of the street, turn on your left signal and look over your left shoulder before entering traffic. If parked on the left side of a one-way street, turn on your right signal and look over your right shoulder before entering traffic.

questions.question: When should you yield your right-of-way?

options.text: Often, even at controlled intersections.
Whenever it helps prevent collisions.
Never. It confuses other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Whenever it helps prevent collisions.
questions.explanation: Never assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way. Yield your right-of-way whenever it helps prevent collisions.

questions.question: This sign means you are approaching a railroad crossing without a signal. You should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop.
Drive at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if you see one.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if you see one.
questions.explanation: At this crossing, slow down, look both ways, and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is near. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: You should adjust your rearview and side mirrors:

options.text: Before you start driving.
Whenever you need to use them.
Before you get into the car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving, adjust your seat, mirrors, and safety belt, and secure items in your vehicle. Do not adjust mirrors while the car is moving.

questions.question: When a school bus is picking up or dropping off children, you must:

options.text: Stop, no matter which direction you are driving.
Stop only if you are driving in the same direction.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, no matter which direction you are driving.
questions.explanation: When a school bus picks up or drops off children, come to a complete stop before reaching the bus, no matter which direction you are driving.

questions.question: The center line has one solid yellow line and one broken yellow line. If the broken line is on your side, it means:

options.text: You cannot pass in this area.
You can pass other vehicles on the left if no traffic is coming toward you.
You can only make right turns here.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass other vehicles on the left if no traffic is coming toward you.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to your lane, you are in a passing zone and may pass if no oncoming traffic is present.

questions.question: This sign shows:

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal vehicle height allowed in this state.
The maximum vehicle width allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: When approaching a curve, you should reduce speed:

options.text: Only if you want to.
Before you enter the curve.
When you are halfway through the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve so you do not have to brake hard inside the curve. Hard braking in a curve may cause a skid and make your vehicle hard to control.

questions.question: After passing a vehicle, it is safe to move back to the right lane:

options.text: After about three seconds.
When you can no longer see the car over your right shoulder.
When you can see the entire front of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see the entire front of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: After passing, return to your lane only when you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror. Always check your blind spots before moving back.

questions.question: You are approaching an intersection with a steady yellow light and have not entered yet. You should:

options.text: Speed up to get through before the red light.
Slow down and proceed carefully through the intersection.
Come to a safe stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a safe stop.
questions.explanation: When you see a steady yellow light, prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection, clear it quickly.

questions.question: If you see a pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane:

options.text: The pedestrian must yield the right-of-way.
You must yield the right-of-way.
Honk your horn to let them know you are there.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog means the pedestrian is blind or partially blind. You must always yield the right-of-way to them.

questions.question: On a multilane road, a dashed yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: Passing is prohibited from both directions.
Passing is permitted from both directions.
Passing is permitted only from the direction next to the dashed line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is permitted only from the direction next to the dashed line.
questions.explanation: When there is a dashed yellow line on your side and a solid yellow line on the other side, only you can pass. Drivers on the solid line side cannot pass.

questions.question: You should not enter an intersection if you will block it when the light turns red:

options.text: Under any circumstances.
Unless you entered the intersection on a yellow light.
Unless you entered the intersection on a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Under any circumstances.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection unless you can drive completely across before the light turns red. Blocking an intersection can result in a citation.

questions.question: Before you enter an intersection, you should look to your:

options.text: Left, your right, then your left again.
Right.
Left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left, your right, then your left again.
questions.explanation: Look left, then right, then left again before entering an intersection. Check for vehicles and pedestrians. Look left a second time because traffic from the left will be closer to you.

questions.question: At a flashing yellow light, you must:

options.text: Wait for the green light before proceeding.
Slow down and cross the intersection carefully.
Stop before crossing the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and cross the intersection carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. Watch for cross traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Disappear into blind spots or are so close that they restrict the truck driver's ability to stop and maneuver safely.
Have sufficient space to travel behind the truck.
Have several car lengths between their vehicle and the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Disappear into blind spots or are so close that they restrict the truck driver's ability to stop and maneuver safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spots around trucks where your car cannot be seen. They are also areas where you are too close for the truck driver to stop or turn safely. Staying in a "No zone" greatly increases crash risk.

questions.question: Under normal conditions, maintain a minimum following distance of:

options.text: One second.
Two seconds.
Three seconds.

questions.correctAnswerText: Three seconds.
questions.explanation: Keep at least three seconds of distance between your vehicle and the vehicle ahead. This gives you time to react if the other driver makes a mistake. Increase this distance in bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: You have a green light but traffic is blocking the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Partially enter the intersection to establish your right-of-way.
Don't enter the intersection until you can get completely across.
Continue into the intersection and wait for traffic to clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Don't enter the intersection until you can get completely across.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, do not enter the intersection unless you can drive all the way through before the light turns red. Blocking the intersection can result in a citation.

questions.question: You should yield to a pedestrian:

options.text: Only if they are in a crosswalk.
At all times, even if the pedestrian is not obeying traffic laws.
Only if the traffic lights are in the pedestrian's favor.

questions.correctAnswerText: At all times, even if the pedestrian is not obeying traffic laws.
questions.explanation: Always watch for pedestrians near your vehicle. Do everything you can to avoid hitting a pedestrian, no matter what the situation is.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No turns.
No outlet.
No U-turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turns.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy traffic going both ways.
